text: The purpose of this report is to provide information and updates on infrastructure, procurement and community engagement related to shelter projects in the City of Toronto. This includes Shelter, Support and Housing Administration's (SSHA) 2022 Shelter Infrastructure Plan as required by the Emergency Shelter Development Process approved by City Council in the 2018 Shelter Infrastructure Plan. The plan includes an update on new permanent shelter beds, relocation of shelter beds as part of the George Street Revitalization Project, and identifying replacement properties for existing shelters that need to relocate. The report also provides updates on the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on all ongoing projects, as well as an overview of the COVID-19 Transition and Relocation plan.
